thread.title: Intraday Update: Dow Jumps 159 Points as Trade Worries Cause Few Worries

author: Brett Arends
title: Intraday Update: Dow Jumps 159 Points as Trade Worries Cause Few Worries
text:
By Brett Arends 2:18 p.m. ET The Dow Jones Industrial Average is up more than 150 points this afternoon. In today's Intraday Update , we:
Illustration: Spencer Platt / Getty Images •...observe that nothing can seem to keep this market down;
•...explain why Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) is tumbling;
•...and highlight Snap's (SNAP) big gain.
Stocks Keep On Keeping On Nothing will make this stock market lie down .
Trade worries are up . Interest rates are up. And the president’s tweets are back up—including one insisting he has a Constitutional right to pardon himself .
Yet the market trudges higher regardless.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average jumped over 200 points at one stage Monday morning before running out of steam. By early afternoon it seemed to be trying to make a new charge upwards. The S&P 500 rose just under half a percent. The Russell 2000 small cap index was back around level after opening higher, falling back and then rallying. Volumes on rising stocks were about twice that on falling stocks on the NYSE, though over on the NASDAQ they were about level.
The main caution here is that a trend usually peaks around about the time scribblers start saying things like, “Nothing will make this stock market lie down.” Let the record show the S&P 500 is now nearing the upward bound of its Bollinger band trading range, a technical measure which might suggest it is overbought.
Sorry to disappoint, but it might suggest nothing at all
Meanwhile oIl fell another 80 cents to a two-month low of $65 a barrel. Yet this isn’t stopping electric car superstar Tesla (TSLA), which is up 2% and is nudging $300. Apple (AAPL), whose World Developers’ Conference opens today in San Jose, is up more than 1% and is bearing down on $200.
The dollar ended the morning about level, after rallying from an early drop. Meanwhile over on the Treasury market the ten-year Treasury yields have broken 2.90%, rising 0.03 percentage points to 2.92%.
S&P 500 : +0.3% to 2743.97
Dow 30 : +159.03, or 0.7%, to 24,794.24
Nasdaq : +0.5% to 7590.48
Vix : -3.0% to 13.06
10-year Treasury Yield : +0.04 percentage point to 2.94%
Midday Movers Bristol Myers Squibb (BMY) is down 5% to $50.49 after Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR)'s presentation about its experimental drug NKTR-214 in conjunction with Bristol Myers' cancer drug Opdivo at the American Society of Clinical Oncology.
Five Below (FIVE) is up 6.6% to $76.08 after JPMorgan initiated coverage with an Overweight rating.
Snap (SNAP) is up 6.3% to $12.37 on an article suggesting that it sell stakes to Apple (AAPL) or Tencent (TCEHY) from The Information .
Under Armour (UAA) is up 3.7% to $22.15, helped by a bullish note from Stifel .
Walmart (WMT) is up 2.4% to $84.96 on news Advent International will invest a majority stake in Walmart Brazil. — Teresa Rivas
